description.narrative: Agrofertil S.A. (Agrofertil or the Company) is a crop input distributor and agronomic services provider headquartered in Ciudad del Este, Paraguay. Founded in 1993, Agrofertil has been an IFC client since 2011. The Company assists farmers, cooperatives and small distributors by providing technical support, agricultural inputs and preharvest financing. The proposed investment consists of an A loan facility of up to US$40 million per year, structured as one-year commitments with annual clean ups. The proposed project is to support the operations of Agrofertil and enhance its capacity to provide farmers with preharvest financing and technical advice (the Project).

IFC expects the Project to improve access to pre-harvesting financing, technical assistance and market for farmers, strengthen global food security, and have positive environmental effects. Beyond the Project, IFC expects its financing to contribute to enhancing the competitiveness of the agricultural inputs market in Paraguay by spearheading the digitization of farming through ramping up the rollout of the first integrated smart agri platform in Paraguay.
